LAB_COMMAND_DONE_74ab8bb67379b284:1')
cases.wrapper_cleanup_observation: Original wrapper log records Stopped lab VMs.
cases.observed: After the first restore on B, the PoolCache API client ended with Resource temporarily unavailable. The helper receive timeout was 30 seconds; the VMM log records the request without a completion response before cleanup.
cases.source_observations: The measured code restored hints from the NFS-backed /disk path and used serde_json::from_reader(File::open(path)?) without a BufReader.
cases.diagnosis: Unbuffered metadata reads over NFS were a plausible contributor. No syscall/RPC trace or isolated timing experiment established an exact amplification factor or proved the timeout mechanism by itself.
cases.fix: Added 64 KiB buffered JSON readers/writers with explicit output flushes, and copied/compared restored hints into an owner-local /run file before starting Firecracker. Full RAM snapshot creation was also moved to local tmpfs, with a separately bounded, byte-compared local/NFS transport step.
cases.validation: Fresh Sync and Async runs using the changes completed B handoffs, NFS refills, and the full promotion/demotion lifecycle.
